cmd.edit.find_replace.desc: Searches text notes, room names and numbers, marks, comments and text parameters across the model. Click a hit to select it; replace one value or all of them in a single undo step.
find_replace.title: Find and replace
find_replace.locked_tip: The value is locked: replace skips it. Unlock it in the properties to change it.
find_replace.pinned_tip: The element is pinned: replace skips it. Unpin it to change the text.
find_replace.empty_hint: Searches notes, rooms, marks, comments and text parameters.
find_replace.none_hint: Check the spelling, or widen the category and level.
find_replace.select_all_tip: Selects every matched element in the model; the window stays open. Then use the properties or a bulk edit on the selection.
find_replace.replace_one_off: Select a result that has something to replace
